name: Sei Shoujo Sentai Lakers III
original_name: 聖少女戦隊レイカーズ III
source:
In the sequel to Sei Shōjo Sentai Lakers II Akira and his team have successfully fended off Rayott's assault and are enjoying a brief peaceful time. However, an enigmatic masked enemy known as Neos Bullard appears on the stage. Aiming to capture the power of Laker crystals, Neos Bullard and his minions invade Earth, taking the Lakers by surprise.

[from [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/sei-shjo-sentai-lakers-iii]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
在《圣少女战队2》的续集中，湖人队II Akira和他的团队成功抵御了雷奥特的攻击，并享受着短暂的平静时光。然而，一个神秘的蒙面敌人尼奥斯·布拉德出现在舞台上。为了夺取湖人水晶的力量，尼奥斯布拉德和他的爪牙入侵地球，让湖人措手不及。

[来自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/sei-shjo-sentai-lakers-iii]MobyGames[/url]]
